sentences.en: Yanni was deployed to a remote area in southern Algeria.
sentences.zh: 亚尼被派往阿尔及利亚南部的一个偏远地区。

sentences.en: China will need to deploy tons of jets to invade Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 中国将需要派遣大量的战机入侵台湾。

sentences.en: CubeSats are tiny satellites that are deployed from the International Space Station.
sentences.zh: 立方体卫星是从国际空间站部署的小型卫星。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：de（使…）+ploy（用）→使用，运用
